mentions.name: CanonicalSchema
mentions.description: A web-based CSV viewer built to handle large files, offering flexible column statistics and filtering to make data easy to understand. The plan is to expand it into a full application for manipulating and analyzing CSV or spreadsheet data.
mentions.problem: None of the existing online CSV tools supported large files or provided flexible column statistics and filtering to easily understand the data.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building https://canonicalschema.com/, I started with a simple CSV viewer because none of the existing online tools supported large files or provided flexible column statistics and filtering to easily understand the data. My plan is to grow it into a full application where users can more easily manipulate and analyze CSV or spreadsheet data.
